card.name: Commas in lists of houseplants
card.fires_on: Commas (and the word 'and') between items in a list of houseplant names, such as peace lily, bamboo palm and spider plant, in a passage about plants cleaning indoor air.

modes.label: Comma after a plant name
modes.description: The comma that follows a houseplant name inside a list of plants.
modes.example: For example, English ivy<<,>> gerbera daisies, pot

modes.label: 'and' before the last plant
modes.description: The word 'and' joining the final plants in a houseplant list.
modes.example: common houseplants such as bamboo palms<< and>> spider plants not only make indoor spaces more
